resources.string: Choose the folder that holds your Warcraft III game files (version 1.31 or newer, including Reforged): the installed game or files extracted with the prep tool. The game reads them where they are. Nothing is copied off the device or uploaded.
Waiting for a folder. Android will ask you to allow access to it.
No game data found here or in the folders inside it. Choose the folder that holds Data and .build.info (installed game) or ui and units (extracted files).
This folder holds a zip file, which the game cannot read. Extract the zip on the phone, then choose the extracted folder.
The game needs access to all files to read this folder. Tap Allow access and turn it on for Warsmash.
Opens only until a valid folder is saved
Next launch goes straight to loading. Change it later: hold the app icon › Game data.
